lines.name: Cash and cash equivalents
lines.why: Cash can repay debt or be paid out: a financial asset. Cash needed to run the business is operating; move it if you know how much.

lines.name: Short-term investments
lines.why: Securities held for the cash they will return: financial.

lines.name: Receivables
lines.why: Owed by customers for sales: operating.

lines.name: Inventory
lines.why: Goods held for sale: operating.

lines.name: Prepaid and other current assets
lines.why: Prepayments and other operating items: operating.

lines.name: Property, plant and equipment
lines.why: Assets used to produce and sell: operating.

lines.name: Operating lease right-of-use assets
lines.why: Leased stores, offices and equipment used in the business: operating.

lines.name: Goodwill
lines.why: Paid for acquired businesses: operating.

lines.name: Intangible assets
lines.why: Acquired technology, brands and customer relationships: operating.

lines.name: Deferred tax assets
lines.why: Taxes on operating income paid ahead: operating.

lines.name: Other non-current assets
lines.why: Other long-term operating items: operating.

lines.name: Accounts payable
lines.why: Owed to suppliers for operations: operating.

lines.name: Accrued liabilities
lines.why: Services and other costs not yet paid: operating.

lines.name: Accrued compensation
lines.why: Wages, bonuses and benefits earned but not yet paid: operating.

lines.name: Deferred revenue
lines.why: Customers' payments ahead of delivery: operating.

lines.name: Income taxes payable
lines.why: Taxes on operating income: operating.

lines.name: Current portion of long-term debt
lines.why: Borrowed money falling due within a year: financial.

lines.name: Long-term debt
lines.why: Bonds, notes and loans: financial.

lines.name: Operating lease liabilities
lines.why: Rent owed on leases used in the business: operating by default. Move it to financing to treat leases like debt (if the balance sheet has no lease line of its own, they sit inside other liabilities).

lines.name: Deferred tax liabilities
lines.why: Taxes on operating income deferred: operating.

lines.name: Other non-current liabilities
lines.why: Other long-term operating obligations: operating.

lines.name: Other current assets, not tagged separately
lines.why: Total current assets minus the current lines above: current assets the company tags its own way. Operating by default.

lines.name: Other non-current assets, not tagged separately
lines.why: Non-current assets (total assets − current assets) minus the non-current lines above: assets the company tags its own way. Operating by default.

lines.name: Other current liabilities, not tagged separately
lines.why: Total current liabilities minus the current lines above: current liabilities the company tags its own way. Operating by default.

lines.name: Other non-current liabilities, not tagged separately
lines.why: Non-current liabilities (total liabilities − current liabilities) minus the non-current lines above: liabilities the company tags its own way. Operating by default.

s.t: Our two largest customers, which operate in the U.S., together accounted for approximately 16.8% and 16.6% of our consolidated net sales in 2025 and 2024, respectively.
No single customer accounted for ten percent or more of our consolidated net sales in either 2025 or 2024.
Our two largest customers together accounted for approximately 16.8% of our consolidated net sales in 2025.

Europe sales generated in 2025 increased $242.1 million, or 4.7%, from sales generated in 2024 primarily from a favorable impact of foreign currency translation and an increase in sales volume of $160.1 million, or 3.1 percentage points, and $130.3 million, or 2.5 percentage points, respectively.
Risk Factors - Our performance depends on favorable labor relations with our employees and our compliance with labor laws.

We rely on information technology networks and systems, including the Internet, to process, transmit, and store electronic and financial information, to manage a variety of business processes and activities, and to comply with regulatory, legal, and tax requirements.
We also depend on our information technology infrastructure for digital marketing activities and for electronic communications among our locations, personnel, customers, and suppliers.
We depend on contract growers and independent producers to supply us with livestock.
Our performance depends on favorable labor relations with our employees and our compliance with labor laws.
We also rely on an adequate supply of skilled employees at our processing and food facilities.
Our ability to make payments on and to refinance our debt, including our credit facilities, would depend on our ability to generate cash in the future.

Any change in dividend policy will depend upon future conditions, including earnings and financial condition, general business conditions, any applicable contractual limitations and other factors deemed relevant by our Board of Directors in its discretion.
Cost of sales incurred by our U.S. operations in 2025 increased $298.8 million, or 3.3%, from cost of sales incurred by our U.S. operations in 2024.

Cost of sales incurred by the Europe operations during 2025 increased $211.0 million, or 4.5%, from cost of sales incurred by the Europe operations during 2024 primarily due to the impact of foreign currency translation and an increase in sales volume of $143.5 million, or 3.1 percentage points, and $118.6 million, or 2.5 percentage points, respectively.

Cost of sales incurred by the Mexico operations during 2025 increased $64.1 million, or 3.5%, from cost of sales incurred by the Mexico operations during 2024 primarily because of an increase in cost per pound sold and an increase in sales volume of $119.2 million, or 6.4 percentage points, and $39.8 million, or 2.2 percentage points, respectively.
Our principal sources of liquidity are cash generated from operations, funds from borrowings, and existing cash on hand.
(a) Based on our feed consumption, a 10% increase in the price of our feed ingredient purchases would have increased cost of sales for the year ended December 28, 2025.
